turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How's voice quality held up for event announcement audio?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Really strong for scripted announcements. Where it struggles is numbers and times read aloud — '3:45 PM' sometimes comes out with an odd pause or gets read as 'three forty five' inconsistently across generations.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, we manually spot-check every announcement with a time or date in it before publishing, which adds friction to an otherwise fast workflow.
